Question: Assalamualaikum 1-How many stages are there in Jannah and what is the highest stage? 2-Please name all the stages in Jannah? 3-How many Doors are there in Jannah and please name all the doors? 4-How many stages are there in Jannah and what is the highest stage? Answer ID: 10841 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 250/250=M/1430) There are hundred categories in Jannah and the highest category is Jannatul Firdaus, as it is mentioned in hadith: عن عبادۃ بن الصامت أن رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم قال: في الجنۃ مائۃ درجۃ، مابین کل درجتین کما بین السماء والأرض، والفردوس أعلاھا درجۃ، و منھا تفجر أنھار الجنۃ الأربعۃ، ومن فوقھا یکون العرش، فإذا سألتم اللہ فاسئلوہ الفردوس (ترمذي) (2) We did not find the names in any hadith. (3) The eight doors of Jannah are: Babul Musalleen, Babus Sayimeen, Babus Sadiqeen, Babul Mutasaddiqeen, Babus Sabireen, Babul Qaniteen, Babul Khashiyeen, Babuz Zakireen (Abu Nayeem, Hilyah 2:16) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
